summary: German long single report without CP. Page 1 is a banner cover with a patient and date block; a clinician summary page follows (empty diagnosis, summary and measures areas, one-line findings, classifier lines with fixed group-match sentences, hard-coded page references), then the table of contents, introduction, questionnaire and test chapters, the core task, EEG, asymmetry, coherence and channel ERP chapters, index, classifier and heart-rate chapters and a fixed recommendation chapter. Its chapter structure is a non-CP sibling of T04.
